struct_class.mechanism: interpret::struct_layout calls aggregate_layout over field TYPES in declaration order and ignores FieldDef::offset entirely, while the producer fills FieldDef::offset from rustc's reorder-aware layout.fields.offset
struct_class.quote_guidance: quote the bracket with the method named, or the method-free field-level 1787 of 4826; never a bare struct count
